Variants.Content: Located on the island of Wonderport in Blackwater Bay, Fairhaven is the domain of House Sanglas and the traditional vassal stronghold of Dragonstone. The island port faces the narrow sea route and relies on ships, fisheries and offshore trade to survive; its political affiliation is often affected by the rise and fall of the Dragonstone side.
Entry Sweetport Sound Local families also rely on fishing, salt production, docks, volcanic rock fields and narrow sea navigation; if any road, well or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Sweetport Sound A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Sweetport Sound They care about fishing, salt industry, wharves, volcanic rock fields and narrow sea shipping. They also care about whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
